about: Screens the mod draws (ImGui overlay on the game's D3D11 swap chain; BO3 fonts and icons read from the player's copy when available).

open.desc: How it opens (settings key id or trigger)

rows.what: Tabs per weapon class; pick a gun, fill attachment slots, Pack-a-Punch toggle for Zombies guns; 'Give' adds it to inventory with ammo
Activating the box (950 gold) plays the BO3 box jingle and cycles guns, then offers one random mystery_box gun; 10% teddy bear: box vanishes and moves
Points bar with the three equipped streaks and their costs, bottom right, BO3 style
rows.open: always while a BO3 gun is equipped

rows.what: If BO3 isn't found: one on-screen notice 'Call of Duty: Black Ops III was not found...' and no guns are offered
rows.source: Melty game_info rule for a secondary game
